title: DR1 lets a trader attach fifteen documents and says so up front; the frontend stops at ten and only mentions a limit once the eleventh is refused.

finding.frontend: The documents collection is capped at ten entries (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/documents.js:19-28). An eleventh attempt is refused before any validation runs, with the summary error "You can add a maximum of 10 documents" pointing at the added-documents table (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/controller.js:92-100). Nothing on the page warns of the cap beforehand: the file requirements hint lists only a size and a set of file types (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:43-49). No captured frontend state shows the refusal — both frontend captures hold zero or one document.
finding.prototype: DR1's ceiling is fifteen and the trader is told before they start: "up to a maximum of 15 files" is the third bullet in the file requirements list. Reaching it is captured at dr1-upload-documents-limit-error — fifteen rows in the table and a single error, "You can upload a maximum of 15 files", shown both in the summary and against the Attachment field, with the rest of the form's validation skipped (app/views/upload-documents.html:165-170).
finding.difference: Raise maxEntries from 10 to 15, restate the error as "You can upload a maximum of 15 files", and add the ceiling to the file requirements bullets so the trader meets it before they hit it. Check the backend's own accompanying-document cap before raising the frontend one — the obligation carries the error code obligation.accompanyingDocument.tooMany, which implies a matching rule on the far side that would reject the eleventh through fifteenth document even after the frontend allows them. Attaching the error to the Attachment field rather than to the table, as DR1 does, is part of the same change.
finding.falsifiedBy: Adding an eleventh document through the frontend and having it saved.

relatedTo.why: both rewrite the same four-line file requirements list
